reviews.text: After getting three quotes, we decided to go with Mendoza Fence LLC and right away knew we made the right decision!  Vincent, Tino and the crew were amazing! We were very impressed with the quality of the vinyl fence, their professionalism and work ethic. They did a beautiful job and took great care with the installation and clean up! Our yard looks incredible and we couldn’t be happier !  We would highly recommend them !

Wow! Vincent and his crew were amazing. From providing the estimate to the actual install, the process was seamless and professional. They removed an old, worn chainlink fence and replaced it with a beuatiful black aluminum pool fence.. I LOVE it! They removed and installed in one "very hot" day and cleaned up to the point that you never knew they were there. Great attention to detail, which is lost on many contractors these days. Highly recommend!

Two weeks ago Vincent and his team installed a beautiful cedar fence around our property- we couldn’t be happier!! Our yard is private and the cedar smells lovely. They were very friendly & talented, I highly recommend!
